text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Matikane Tannhauser! Tokyo 
Racecourse stands in utter disbelief!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon senses that Rice 
Shower will be a threat in the Kikuka Sho 
and declares war. The crowd goes wild 
seeing the rivalry between the two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An equal amount of applause as that given 
to Matikanetannhauser was sent towards the 
two of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing this phenomenon, a few spectators 
frowned, wondering, "Isn't that a bit rude 
to Machitan?" However, the person in 
question didn't mind in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiastic post on social media 
declaring, "I'll do my best in the Kikuka 
Sho next!" garnered quite a positive 
reputation for being so refreshingly 
optimistic.
